name: garmin-mcp
description: Read-only access to your own Garmin Connect data: sleep, HRV, recovery, activities, training load and performance.
long_description:
Talk to Claude about your training and recovery with your real Garmin data behind it.

- **Recovery:** sleep, overnight HRV against your baseline, training readiness, resting heart rate, body battery and stress, in one call.
- **Training:** recent activities, laps and heart rate zones, weekly load and intensity, training status and load balance, planned workouts.
- **Performance:** VO2 max, race predictions, endurance and hill score, fitness age, lactate threshold and personal records.
- **Trends:** day-by-day sleep, HRV, resting HR, readiness, body battery, stress, steps, intensity minutes, weight or VO2 max over up to 90 days.

Everything is read-only. Your email and password are kept in your system keychain and are only used when there is no saved Garmin session. The session tokens are stored in `~/.garminconnect`. If your account uses two-step verification, Claude asks you for the code the first time.
